rolling_sensor_in_energy.title: Energy Dashboard is using a Contact Energy rolling-total sensor
rolling_sensor_in_energy.description:
Your Energy Dashboard uses {entities}. These sensors show a total for the last few days, so the dashboard gets spikes, negative bars and wrong totals. Contact's data is also 1-2 days behind; the statistics record each hour at the time it was used, while a sensor is recorded when Home Assistant fetches it.

To fix it, go to **Settings > Dashboards > Energy** and replace them:

- For consumption, use the **Contact Energy** and **Contact Energy Free** statistics.
- For cost, choose **Use an entity tracking the total costs** and pick **Contact Energy Cost** and **Contact Energy Free Cost**.

Then run the **Import historical data** action once with **Clear existing data** on to rebuild your history. This warning clears the next time Contact Energy reloads.
